messages:
sarah-peopleops: Heads-up — offer for Priya (London) needs a comp-band uplift + benefits backdate request. Hiring manager asked for start 2026-04-01 but payroll won't onboard until 2026-04-15. She needs continuous UK benefits (pension/health) from 04/01. Can we route an exception for backdating and approve band band5->band6 uplift?

jake-hiring: Context: Priya is a senior infra engineer with active competing offers. We offered band5 but hiring manager requested band6 to match market. Candidate accepted verbally pending formal paperwork. Start date is firm 04/01 — they can do onboarding remote first two weeks.

lara-finance: Quick flags: Payroll cutoff for April is 04/10 for UK payroll cycle. Retro pay and benefits backdate are possible but need Finance + People Ops approval and a note in payroll batch. Tax implications for pension contributions if we backdate. Also need confirmation of relocation stipend timing.

emily-talent: I'm +1 on speeding this. If we can't backdate benefits, candidate will need to wait for pension enrollment which could be a dealbreaker. Can we do an interim benefits enrollment (manual) starting 04/01?

ben-legal: From compliance side: we can backdate enrollment for benefits if there's an auditable approval trail and candidate paperwork signed effective 04/01. For pension, employer contributions may need HMRC reporting adjustments. Recommend limiting backdate to 14 days to reduce risk.

sarah-peopleops: Thanks. Proposed path: 1) Approve provisional band uplift (band6) conditional on final sign-off from CFO. 2) Approve benefits backdate up to 14 days with payroll note and legal sign-off. 3) Onboarding team to do manual benefits enrollment effective 04/01. Is everyone ok?

lara-finance: Conditional OK from Finance pending CFO note. We'll need cost impact calc for uplift and any employer NI adjustments. I can produce numbers by EOD.

jake-hiring: Can we get CFO sign-off today? Hiring manager is on standby. Candidate prefers an official letter by EOD.

emily-talent: I'll get the signed offer scanned and timestamped for legal. Also can we include a clause about contingent payroll adjustments?

ben-legal: Please send the scanned signed offer with effective date 04/01 to legal@redwood. We'll draft the approval language for the backdate and the 14-day cap.

onboard-bot: Checklist update: "manual-benefits-enroll" assigned to @sarah-peopleops, due 2026-04-01. "payroll-backdate-note" assigned to @lara-finance, due 2026-04-02.

sarah-peopleops: Lara, can you ping CFO (maria-cfo) for formal sign-off once you have the numbers? I'll hold the uplift approval until then.

lara-finance: Will do. I have a short calc: uplift cost delta = ~£9,500 annualized, monthly ~£790. Employer NI + pension adj for 14 days ~= £60 one-time. Sharing in thread in 30m.

jake-hiring: Thanks. If CFO signs, we also need people-ops to issue the corrected offer letter today. Priya is waiting.

emily-talent: Signed offer is uploaded to GH drive link: https://redwood.app/drive/priyaa-offer-signed.pdf (private). Sent to legal now.

ben-legal: Reviewed. Draft approval text: "People Ops and Finance approve benefits enrollment effective 2026-04-01, retroactive to candidate start date, not to exceed 14 days. Any payroll tax adjustments to be handled by Finance." Approve?

sarah-peopleops: Approve that wording.

lara-finance: Approve. I've looped Maria-CFO; waiting on her ack.

maria-cfo: (via DM to Lara) I've reviewed the uplift impact. Approve band6 and benefits backdate up to 14 days. Finance to implement payroll note and absorb one-time NI adj.

lara-finance: Maria approved. Final: band6 uplift approved, benefits enrollment backdated to 04/01 (max 14 days). Sarah to issue updated offer and onboard-bot to trigger manual enrollment.

sarah-peopleops: Thanks everyone — I'll send the updated offer with new band and effective date now and cc legal + finance. Priya signing confirmation will be posted here. :thumbsup:

jake-hiring: Awesome — candidate signed at 14:42. We're green.

onboard-bot: Task completed: "manual-benefits-enroll" by @sarah-peopleops (timestamp 2456789100). "payroll-backdate-note" by @lara-finance (timestamp 2456789110).

sarah-peopleops: Closing thread — routing to HR records to capture exception (exception-id: EXC-2026-042).
